question.text: The differential equation of the family of circles passing through the origin and having centre at the line $y=x$ is :

options.text: $\left(x^2-y^2+2 x y\right) \mathrm{d} x=\left(x^2-y^2-2 x y\right) \mathrm{d} y$
$\left(x^2+y^2+2 x y\right) \mathrm{d} x=\left(x^2+y^2-2 x y\right) \mathrm{d} y$
$\left(x^2+y^2-2 x y\right) \mathrm{d} x=\left(x^2+y^2+2 x y\right) \mathrm{d} y$
$\left(x^2-y^2+2 x y\right) \mathrm{d} x=\left(x^2-y^2+2 x y\right) \mathrm{d} y$

solution.text:
$\begin{aligned}
& C \equiv x^2+y^2+g x+g y=0....(1)\\
& 2 x+2 y y^{\prime}+g+g y^{\prime}=0 \\
& g=-\left(\frac{2 x+2 y y^{\prime}}{1+y^{\prime}}\right)
\end{aligned}$
Put in (1)
$\begin{aligned}
& x^2+y^2-\left(\frac{2 x+2 y y^{\prime}}{1+y^{\prime}}\right)(x+y)=0 \\
& \left(x^2-y^2-2 x y\right) y^{\prime}=x^2-y^2+2 x y
\end{aligned}$
